entries.text: `scripts/stage_seed_corpus_bundle.py --internal-manifest` now writes the maintainer submission manifest (`result_source: internal`, per-file SHA-256) next to the anonymized bundle, so a locally produced result passes `scripts/validate_submission.py --require-manifest` without a hand-written sidecar. Raw local runs still fail that check by design: they carry absolute database paths and unredacted tuning diagnostics until the public anonymiser has run.
